{{Hatnote|For the era article, see [[Virtual Original]]. For later Blocks, see [[Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)]]. Full constructed pool: [[Premiere - Original VS17]].}}
The '''Virtual Sets (2002-2009)''' are the numbered Virtual Sets released by the [[Players Committee]] during the [[Virtual Original]] era. They were printable PDF slips sleeved over Decipher cards.<ref name="tfn2002">[https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Player's Committee Announces the First Virtual Card Set], TheForce.Net, 12 February 2002 (citing Game Players Network). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020214905/https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Internet Archive].</ref> Virtual Set 1 became tournament-legal on 9 March 2002.<ref name="decivs1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020610072829/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee/virtualcardset1.html Virtual Card Set #1 is Away!], decipher.com (Wayback, 10 June 2002 snapshot; dated 5 March 2002)</ref> The complete constructed pool is [[Premiere - Original VS17]].

Fifth Anthology was previewed as Virtual Set 18 and shipped inside [[Virtual Block 6]] (official text 4 September 2009).<ref name="plfifth" /><ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> It has no standalone VirtualCards18.pdf. See [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]] for Galaxy At War.
